explanation.change: InputEventKey and InputEventMouse default to DEVICE_ID_KEYBOARD (16) and DEVICE_ID_MOUSE (32) in 4.7 (their constructors, :669 and :715), and InputMap::action_add_event rewrites a device-0 key or mouse event to them (core/input/input_map.cpp:211); in 4.6 they are device 0, so action matching and get_device differ
